user.title: Gubbins inventory bridge
user.description: Connect to your local Gubbins bridge. The token is an API token minted in the Gubbins app (Users → an account → API tokens); it is stored securely by Home Assistant and never written to YAML.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Gubbins inventory bridge
zeroconf_confirm.description: Discovered a Gubbins bridge at {host}:{port}. Enter its access token (an API token minted in the Gubbins app (Users → an account → API tokens)) to finish. The token is never advertised over the network — it is stored securely by Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Gubbins inventory bridge
reauth_confirm.description: The bridge at {host}:{port} no longer accepts the stored token — it was probably revoked or rotated. Mint a new API token in the Gubbins app (Users → an account → API tokens) and enter it here to reconnect.

reconfigure.title: Gubbins inventory bridge
reconfigure.description: Update where the bridge lives. Re-enter the access token — Home Assistant never displays a stored token, so it cannot be pre-filled here.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the bridge. Check the host and port, and that the bridge is running.
error.invalid_auth: The bridge did not recognise the token. It may have been mistyped, or revoked in the Gubbins app.

abort.already_configured: This Gubbins bridge is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: Reconnected to the Gubbins bridge with the new token.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The Gubbins bridge details were updated.

search.name: Search inventory
search.description: Search the Gubbins inventory (read-only) and return matching items, along with the resolved location ids for each match.

query.name: Query
query.description: Free text, or the power-user syntax (e.g. cap:voltage>3.3).

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (1–25).

adjust_quantity.name: Adjust quantity (stock in / out)
adjust_quantity.description: Change a discrete item's stock by a signed amount. This moves a number only — to record that someone has borrowed the item, use Check out instead. Requires the bridge to be started with GUBBINS_BRIDGE_ALLOW_WRITES=on; the change syncs back to the app conflict-free.

item_id.name: Item id
item_id.description: The Gubbins record id of the item (find it via the search service or the API).

delta.name: Delta
delta.description: Signed change: negative for stock going out, positive for stock coming in.

note.name: Note
note.description: Optional note recorded in the item's activity log.

adjust_gauge.name: Adjust gauge (use / refill a consumable)
adjust_gauge.description: Change how much is in a measured consumable — grams of filament, millilitres of resin — by a signed amount. Requires the bridge to be started with GUBBINS_BRIDGE_ALLOW_WRITES=on; the change syncs back to the app conflict-free.

item_id.name: Item id
item_id.description: The Gubbins record id of the consumable (find it via the search service or the API).

delta.name: Delta
delta.description: Signed change in the item's own unit, and may be fractional: negative for an amount used, positive for a refill.

note.name: Note
note.description: Optional note recorded in the item's activity log.

check_out.name: Check out (lend an item)
check_out.description: Lend an item to a person, a project or a place, optionally with a due date. Unlike adjusting a quantity this records who has it, so it shows as on loan and becomes overdue if the due date passes. Requires the bridge to be started with GUBBINS_BRIDGE_ALLOW_WRITES=on, and an account with permission to lend; the change syncs back to the app conflict-free.

item_id.name: Item id
item_id.description: The Gubbins record id of the item to lend (find it via the search service or the API).

contact_name.name: Borrower name
contact_name.description: Lend to a person by name. If nobody of that name exists yet, they are added — exactly as lending in the app would. Supply only one borrower.

contact_id.name: Contact id
contact_id.description: Lend to an existing contact by id, instead of by name. Supply only one borrower.

project_id.name: Project id
project_id.description: Lend to a project rather than a person. Supply only one borrower.

location_id.name: Borrowing location id
location_id.description: Lend to a place, such as a van. This is where the item has gone, not where it came from. Supply only one borrower.

quantity.name: Quantity
quantity.description: How many units to lend. Defaults to 1; a serialised item always goes out as one.

due_date.name: Due date
due_date.description: The day it should come back. It only counts as overdue once that day has ended. Leave empty for an open-ended loan.

from_location_id.name: Lend from location id
from_location_id.description: Take the units from this location; the return puts them back there. Defaults to the item's own location.

note.name: Note
note.description: Optional note recorded on the loan and in the item's activity log.

check_in.name: Check in (return a lent item)
check_in.description: Return a lent item, putting the stock back where it came from and closing the loan. Requires the bridge to be started with GUBBINS_BRIDGE_ALLOW_WRITES=on, and an account with permission to lend; the change syncs back to the app conflict-free.

item_id.name: Item id
item_id.description: The Gubbins record id of the item coming back (find it via the search service or the API).

checkout_id.name: Loan id
checkout_id.description: Which loan to close. Only needed when the item is out on more than one loan at once — otherwise the single open loan is used.

note.name: Note
note.description: Optional note recorded on the return, e.g. what state it came back in.
